notes.title: Store Page is now Live!
notes.notes: Let's get together and get hyped for RAPTORS VS. GOBLINS store page launch! For those new to the project, this is a tower Deck Building Tower Defense game. Fight against waves of goblins and reap the rewards! Regular updates and posts will be made more public now that I have more of project to show you all. I am looking forward to the future of RvG!
